title: Exterior Styling Appreciation
summary: This topic centers on favorable comments about the F70's styling, while many sampled fragments mention styling without enough context to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews explicitly praise the car's styling as great, good, excellent, or something owners really like or love.

undetermined.summary: Many fragments refer to styling only briefly, so the sentiment cannot be determined from the provided text.

limitations: Most undetermined examples are very short mentions such as 'the styling,' which do not provide enough context for a reliable sentiment interpretation.
The sampled evidence is narrowly focused on styling and does not clarify whether reviewers mean exterior styling, interior styling, or both in every case.
Examples are limited and stratified rather than representative, so they should not be used to infer broader prevalence beyond this topic sample.
